source.title: Contract Rules (Part [] of the Constitution), with Appendices A–C

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for goods and services contracts (sub-central authorities)
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.defined_by: clause 1.4 and App B footnote *** refer to the Procurement Legislation and the Procurement intranet page
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure, its VAT basis and its source before spend-analyst runs.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for works and concession contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply with source.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for light touch contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply with source.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.description: 'the (relevant/appropriate) Threshold' where the text does not fix the contract type: resolves per contract to the goods/services, works/concession or light touch threshold above
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.defined_by: clause 1.4 ('relevant financial thresholds relating to Goods & Services, Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts')
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.note: Not a separate figure; spend-analyst must map each transaction/contract to one of the three thresholds (the spend data has no reliable contract-type field, so the auditor should confirm the mapping).

notes: VAT basis conflict: clause 6.15 says Total Contract Value includes 'Value Added Tax', while the Appendix B column header states 'Total Value exclusive of VAT'. Spend data 'Net amount' is ex-VAT; the auditor should confirm which basis applies to the Appendix B bands.
Placeholders left in the text: the title reads 'Part []' and Appendix A row 3 refers to 'Parts [] (CallIn) and [] (Forward Plan)'.

Band gaps at exactly £500,000: Appendix A row 2 is 'less than £500,000' and row 3 'Above £500,000'; Appendix B row B2 is 'less than £500,000' and row C 'Above £500,000'. A contract of exactly £500,000 falls in no band. Similarly Appendix B row A starts 'Above £1,000', so exactly £1,000 is in no band.
Appendix A row 4 is headed '£2.5million or more' but its text says 'in excess of £2.5million'; row 3 is 'less than £2.5million'. Exactly £2.5million is treated inconsistently.

Threshold boundary inconsistency: Appendix A row 1 is 'up to relevant Threshold' (inclusive) while Appendix B row B1 is 'less than the Threshold' and 7.4.1 'up to the Threshold'; Appendix C row E is 'below' / 'greater than' the Threshold, leaving exactly-Threshold variations undefined.

Clause 5.2 (Transparency Code) requires publication of every invitation to tender over £5,000, while Appendix B row A (£1,000–£25,000) states advertising 'None mandated'. Not strictly contradictory (publication vs advertising) but the auditor should note the two figures.

Waiver authority tension: 7.2.2 allows exceptions 'at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive', while 7.3 says 'Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception'.

Clause 7.2 sets the exception regime at 'more than £24,999.99', but 7.4.1 requires S.151 approval 'for all contracts up to the Threshold' (no lower bound), so it is unclear whether exceptions below £25,000 need S.151 approval.

Drafting errors: 7.4.2 reads 'provided and an exception report'; Appendix A row 4 reads 'the relevant Service Director / to award'; Appendix A row 3 'such decision have been made'; Appendix C row C omits a connector ('no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken') and ends with a dangling '; or'; Appendix C row E (a variation) refers to 'an extension report'; Appendix C's closing note says 'exemption' where the table uses 'exclusion'.

Appendix C row C cross-refers to 'Purchasing Scheme (refer to 8 above)': clause 8.2 requires only that advice be sought, whereas App C row C requires prior written Monitoring Officer approval when no further competition is held.
Clause 6.11 refers to tenderers 'from other member states' (EU wording) and 6.10/6.19 to the CDP; the PDF is dated (per CLAUDE.md) Sept 2025 under PA2023, so 6.11 appears to be legacy wording.
Clause 11.11 lists 'goods, services, works or concession contracts' for sealing above Threshold but omits light touch contracts, which Appendix B covers.

Statutory thresholds are not stated anywhere in the PDF (1.4, 6.5 and App B footnote *** point to the Procurement intranet page); every rule bounded by 'the Threshold' carries a parameter reference awaiting the auditor's figure.
Plain-text extraction renders Appendix A row 3's 'Call-In' as 'CallIn'; the quote in CPR-51 follows the plain text as the skill requires.

rules.condition: procurement of a service contract with estimated value exceeding the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: Record consideration of how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire (Social Value Act 2012 and Social Value Policy).
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Ensure every contract is made in accordance with a decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision-maker within the Scheme of Delegation (4.1.1–4.1.3.3).
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; an Executive Decision Maker, a Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or an officer or their delegate under the Scheme of Delegation
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision:

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Enter into a contract only where there is existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award with a value over £500,000
rules.required_action: Treat the award as a Key Decision of the Council.
rules.approver: Key Decision of the Council
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: expenditure exceeding £500
rules.required_action: Publish details of all expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors (Local Government Transparency Code 2015).
rules.verbatim_quote: Under the Local Government Transparency Code 2015, councils must publish: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for a goods and/or services contract with a value exceeding £5,000
rules.required_action: Publish details of every invitation to tender for goods and/or services contracts with a value over £5,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: all contracts in progress and awarded
rules.required_action: Publish a register of contracts (in progress and awarded) showing key information such as contract value, duration and supplier.
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: contract information held by service areas
rules.required_action: Report contract information to the relevant board monthly.
rules.approver: relevant board (recipient)
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold (Further Competition via compliant Framework excepted)
rules.required_action: Advertise the opportunity on the CDP database before it appears in any other advertising medium.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc). However, where a Further Competition is undertaken via a compliant Framework Agreement, an invitation will be sent to those providers on the Framework only and no further advertisement will be required.

rules.condition: every CDP notice
rules.required_action: Have every CDP notice approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate.
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.condition: any contract, at any value
rules.required_action: Do not artificially split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules.
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: contract with estimated value more than the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: Issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and require tenders to be submitted electronically via the Council’s Procurement Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: every electronic tender
rules.required_action: Specify the electronic tender format in the Portal and ITT, and store tenders in a secure portal account locked until the specified opening date and time.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the specified opening time and date
rules.required_action: Reject late tenders unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: every tender submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Have tenders opened electronically by a Procurement Officer, with an audit record maintained on the e-tendering system.
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: every quote and tender
rules.required_action: Evaluate quotes and tenders against evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting them.
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: every contract award
rules.required_action: Award on the most advantageous, best-value quote or tender (having regard to the Social Value Policy), not lowest price alone, unless the relevant Service Director approved an exception in advance.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (advance approval of exceptions)
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: exception or waiver of competition for a contract with value more than £24,999.99
rules.required_action: Except or waive the competitive purchasing requirement only in a circumstance listed in 7.2.1 (urgency, contracts not subject to the Procurement Legislation) or 7.2.2, and subject to 7.4.
rules.verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: exception or waiver under 7.2 on discretionary grounds (value more than £24,999.99)
rules.required_action: Record in writing the reasons for an exception made at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive.
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: any waiver of or exception to these Rules
rules.required_action: Have waivers or exceptions granted only by the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer, sought only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval of the exception.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer to consult the Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director, with an exception report approved by the relevant board (retrospective report only where 7.3 urgency applies).
rules.approver: S.151 Officer, consulting the Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director; relevant board approves the exception report
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.condition: exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer to recommend the exception to the Executive, with an exception report prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.
rules.approver: the Executive, on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board and Corporate Board approve the exception report
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: every exception or waiver
rules.required_action: Fully document every exception or waiver.
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must:

rules.condition: exception or waiver for a contract whose competition requirement is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Submit a written exception report, with reasons showing the waiver is genuinely required, in advance to the relevant board.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director submits; relevant board receives
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.condition: every exception or waiver
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval, with a record that the reasons were considered and the circumstances are genuinely exceptional.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional (applications for waivers which are a result of poor contract planning will rarely be considered genuinely exceptional);

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, dynamic market, consortium etc.)
rules.required_action: Before using a Purchasing Scheme, obtain advice confirming the Council is entitled to use it, the purchases fall within its coverage, and it complies with the Procurement Legislation and Council requirements (8.2.1–8.2.3).
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Produce a written report documenting key decisions, steps and stages leading to the award.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (author)
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation (the Procurement Legislation places an obligation on the Council to document, for each procurement, key decisions and steps taken and stages leading to the award of contracts).

rules.condition: every 9.1 award report
rules.required_action: Retain the 9.1 award report for three years.
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: every procurement procedure, regardless of value
rules.required_action: Document the progress of the procurement (communications, deliberations, documents, negotiation, selection, award) and keep it for three years from award.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director
rules.verbatim_quote: In addition to the above, the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value) including ensuring sufficient information is kept to justify decisions such as communications with contractors and internal deliberations, preparation of procurement documents, any dialogue and negotiation, selection and award. Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: every purchase
rules.required_action: Hold written (including electronic) evidence of every purchase.
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: every contract within the Appendix B bands
rules.required_action: Put the contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: every contract document sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Have Legal Services retain all sealed contract documents.
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: every contract award
rules.required_action: Formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement of the award so it is recorded on the Council Contract Register.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (notifies)
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: amendment of a Standard Form of Agreement
rules.required_action: Have any amended form of contract approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: every contract (where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include minimum clauses covering scope, time, quality, insurance, default, legal compliance, data protection, anti-bribery cancellation and payment within 30 days with flow-down to subcontracts (10.7.1–10.7.9.2).
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment for every contract to inform its data clauses.
rules.approver: Service Directors (responsible)
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements that are enforceable.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements which are prepared taking into account the need for effectiveness of delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency (as appropriate) and the need to be able to enforce the delivery of those requirements.

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities
rules.required_action: Obtain written authorisation from the Monitoring Officer and S.151 Officer before relaxing full indemnities.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: performance bond required (contract estimated over £500,000 under 11.2)
rules.required_action: Use a bond form approved by Legal Services and include it in the Invitation to Tender.
rules.approver: Legal Services
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: contract estimated to exceed £500,000 (works, or supplies/services by a date) where no performance bond is required
rules.required_action: Undertake a written risk assessment, seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property, and keep the risk assessment on the contract file (11.4.1–11.4.3).
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must:

rules.condition: every contract whose risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: Set and verify adequate insurance cover, CIS status (construction) and professional indemnity levels in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property (11.5.1–11.5.4).
rules.approver: Service Director, in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk. If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must:

rules.condition: any document to which the Seal is affixed
rules.required_action: Affix the Seal only to documents approved by resolution of the Council, Executive or an appropriate Committee, or by an officer with delegated powers.
rules.approver: the Council, Executive, an appropriate Committee, or an officer with delegated powers
rules.verbatim_quote: The Seal may be affixed, physically or electronically, to any document or proposal that has been approved by a resolution of the Council or Executive, or of an appropriate Committee, or by an officer with delegated powers.

rules.condition: every affixing of the Seal
rules.required_action: Have the sealing attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or a duly designated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.condition: every sealing of a document
rules.required_action: Record each sealing as a consecutively numbered entry in the sealing book/record, signed by the attesting person.
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.condition: goods, services, works or concession contract with value above Threshold
rules.required_action: Seal the contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: execution of a document not required by law to be under seal
rules.required_action: Have the document signed by the Monitoring Officer or a designated officer, and record it in the register kept by the Monitoring Officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: selection and instruction of Counsel
rules.required_action: Have Counsel selected and instructed only by the Monitoring Officer or nominated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer) shall have discretion to select and instruct Counsel.

rules.condition: total contract value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Award under the delegated authority of the relevant Service Director (or officers nominated in writing).
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing)
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: total contract value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Award by the relevant Service Director on recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer, with a written report provided and approved by the relevant board.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); relevant board approves the report
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: total contract value above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Treat the award as a Key Decision by the relevant Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, on recommendation of the Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer, with a board-approved written report and Call-In/Forward Plan compliance.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); relevant board approves the report
rules.verbatim_quote: The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided: a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and b) such decision have been made in accordance with Parts [] (CallIn) and [] (Forward Plan).

rules.condition: total contract value £2.5million or more
rules.required_action: Obtain Executive approval (or Executive-delegated authority via quarterly reports) to award, in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer.
rules.approver: the Executive (may delegate to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below. The Executive shall receive quarterly reports detailing contracts being procured and seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract following the procurement process in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer.

rules.condition: total value exclusive of VAT above £1,000 and less than £25,000
rules.required_action: Seek at least one quote from an appropriate source (no advertising mandated).
rules.verbatim_quote: At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods or services, total value exclusive of VAT £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible; publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, total value exclusive of VAT £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible; publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, total value exclusive of VAT above £500,000 and less than the Threshold (works/concession or light touch threshold as applicable)
rules.required_action: Run a full competitive tender seeking at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal; place an advert on the Portal with information on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal. An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: goods, services, works, concession or light touch contract, total value exclusive of VAT above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Follow the Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders (where appropriate) via the Procurement Portal; advertise on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal. An advert should be placed on the CDP

rules.condition: contract excluded from competition under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: Record key decisions and follow the relevant PSR process.
rules.verbatim_quote: Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: contract awarded under a Purchasing Scheme without further competition
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: extension of an existing contract where the contract provides for extension
rules.required_action: Obtain S151 Officer approval for the extension.
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is an extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension. Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract (permitted by the contract or legislation), contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer for the variation.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract, contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain approval of the relevant board following an extension report with recommendation from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer.
rules.approver: relevant board, on recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: individual social care placements/packages listed in row F (a)–(f)
rules.required_action: Record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual’s case notes.
rules.approver: Service Directors (responsible)
